retrieval_skill.name: regime_transition_context
retrieval_skill.description: Retrieve both the current operating regime and the immediately preceding baseline so forecasts can distinguish a sustained level shift from short-lived noise.
retrieval_skill.applicability: When the forecast target may be driven by occupancy, operating-state, or other discrete regime changes.
retrieval_skill.query_strategy: Search for the state at the forecast origin, expected state persistence across the full horizon, the most recent transition, and qualitative or measured comparisons with the prior stable baseline.
retrieval_skill.verification_rule: Accept a regime-shift claim only when evidence establishes the forecast-start state and supports persistence through the relevant temporal window; require explicit provenance for quoted or measured changes and do not infer unsupported magnitudes.
